LESSON: ZAKAT AND ZAKATUL FITR

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Zakat and Zakatul Fitr

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Zakat and Zakatul Fitr
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to pay Zakat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim
2. identify items exempted from Zakat payment
3. appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim
• Model 2: identify items exempted from Zakat payment
• Model 3: appreciate the role of zakat in the development of a Muslim society

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe Zakatul Maal and Zakatul Fitr as an obligation on a Muslim
2. Practise: identify items exempted from Zakat payment

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.
